cnTitle: 紫微斗数自化还分方向：向心自化、离心自化、视同自化差在哪
enTitle: Three Directions of Self-Transformation in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Centripetal, Centrifugal and Treated-As
enDesc: When a palace's own stem transforms a star inside it, an arrow pointing toward the palace center is centripetal, away from it centrifugal, and a transformation from the opposite palace into it is treated-as self-transformation. Direction decides whether energy is pulled in or pushed out; reading Lu/Ji without direction can reverse the verdict.
cnDesc: 同样是宫位天干让本宫星曜自化，箭头指向宫位中心叫向心、背离中心叫离心、对宫化入本宫叫视同自化；方向不同，一件事是「自己收回来」还是「自己推出去」完全相反，光看化禄化忌不看方向会断反。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数飞星断事：什么是三象一物、宫象星怎么合一
enTitle: Flying-Star Reading in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Three Signs, One Event and How Palace, Star and Transformation Merge
enDesc: To read a concrete event you need three kinds of information: the palace sets the life domain, the star sets the manner and the person, and the transformation sets the state in which it happens. When several palaces send the same sign toward one event, that is three-signs-one-event; a single point never makes a verdict.
cnDesc: 断一件具体的事要凑齐三类信息：宫位定「在哪个领域」、星曜定「用什么方式、什么人」、四化定「以什么状态发生」，这叫宫、象、星三合一，多个宫位化出同一类象、共同指向同一件事，就是三象一物，单点不成断。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数四化会互相打架：权忌交战、科忌缠斗、禄忌相冲怎么读
enTitle: When the Four Transformations Clash in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Quan-Ji Battle, Ke-Ji Tangle and Lu-Ji Opposition
enDesc: When one star or palace carries two transformations, tension forms: Quan meeting Ji is the tug of wanting control yet being blocked, Ke meeting Ji is the tangle of wanting grace amid recurring trouble, Lu meeting Ji is simultaneous gain and loss. They do not cancel; read which dominates and in which stage.
cnDesc: 一颗星或一个宫位同时承接两种化象时会形成张力：化权遇化忌是想掌控却被卡住的拉扯，化科遇化忌是想体面却不断出状况的缠斗，化禄遇化忌是得失并存、一边得一边失，读法不是抵消，而是看谁占上风、分在什么阶段。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化忌有四层：生年忌、飞化忌、自化忌、流年忌怎么分轻重
enTitle: Four Layers of Hua Ji in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Natal, Flying, Self and Annual Ji and How to Rank Them
enDesc: Hua Ji arrives on four layers: natal Ji is the lifelong core lesson, decade-stem flying Ji is the knot of these ten years, self-Ji is the palace dissipating or internalizing on its own, and annual Ji is this year's temporary pressure. A real high-risk window opens when all four strike one palace; unable to separate one layer from a stack causes needless panic.
cnDesc: 一张盘里化忌会从四个层面叠上来：生年忌是这辈子反复出现的根本课题，大限宫干飞化忌是这十年新结的结，自化忌是这宫自己往外推或往内耗，流年忌是今年临时压上来的事；四层同时打到一个宫位才是真正的高发期，分不清单层还是叠加就会过度恐慌。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数一张盘信号打架时先信谁：亮度、四化、三方、对宫的证据排序
enTitle: When Signals Conflict in a Zi Wei Chart: Ranking Brightness, Transformations, Trines and the Opposite Palace
enDesc: One palace often carries contradictory signals: a fallen star yet with Hua Lu, auspicious and malefic stars together, a good home palace with a poor opposite. Do not cherry-pick; rank evidence by brightness as the power base, natal transformations as the innate tone, triple-direction as support structure, opposite palace as hidden pull, and flanking/minor stars only as adjustments—earlier items set the tone.
cnDesc: 同一宫位常有互相矛盾的信号：主星落陷却化禄、吉星煞星同宫、本宫好对宫差。这时不能挑自己想听的，要按「本宫主星亮度定力量底子→生年四化定先天基调→三方四正定支援结构→对宫定隐性牵引→夹宫与杂曜只做加减分」的顺序排证据权重，越靠前越能定调。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数的体用：为什么命宫是体、所问之宫是用，看盘要会切换
enTitle: Ti and Yong in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Life Is the Body and the Asked Palace the Function, and How to Switch
enDesc: Ti (body) is who experiences it—always the Life Palace and the chart holder's whole structure; yong (function) is the matter asked, landing in Wealth, Spouse, Career and so on. Every topic is the Life body carrying a specific function palace: establish the Life body first, then read the function palace, so you never paste another person's fine pattern onto yourself.
cnDesc: 体是「谁在经历」，永远是命宫与命主的整体结构；用是「正在问的那件事」，落在财帛、夫妻、官禄等具体宫位。任何专题都是「以命宫的体去承载某个用宫的事」，先立住命宫这个体，再看用宫强弱，才不会把别人盘上的好格局错套到自己身上。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数盘为什么是九宫格：洛书轨迹、宫位数字和气流方向
enTitle: Why a Zi Wei Chart Is a Nine-Grid: Luo Shu Paths, Palace Numbers and Energy Flow
enDesc: The twelve palaces sit in a nine-grid rooted in the Luo Shu numbers: nine at the head, one at the feet, three left, seven right, two and four at the shoulders, six and eight at the feet, five in the center. Understanding this fixed numerology and flow direction helps you memorize palace positions and why clockwise/counterclockwise and trines are taken as they are; it is a spatial coordinate, not another set of spirits to memorize.
cnDesc: 斗数命盘的十二宫布在九宫格里，背后是洛书的数字轨迹：戴九履一、左三右七、二四为肩、六八为足、五居中宫，理解这套固定数位和气流顺逆，能帮你记住宫位相对位置、看懂「顺行逆行」「三方」为什么这么取，它是空间坐标，不是又一套要背的神煞。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数宫干怎么来：五虎遁安宫干、五鼠遁安流时天干的排盘基础
enTitle: Where Palace Stems Come From in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Five-Tiger for Palace Stems and Five-Rat for Hour Stems
enDesc: The stem above each palace is not random: palace stems derive from the birth-year stem via the Five-Tiger rule starting at Yin for the first month, while flowing-hour stems derive from the day stem via the Five-Rat rule starting at Zi. Palace stems are the origin of flying transformations; get them wrong and every later flying transformation is wrong—a required skill for casting and checking charts.
cnDesc: 每个宫位上方的天干不是随便排的：宫干由出生年干用「五虎遁寅」起正月推得，流时天干则由日干用「五鼠遁子」起子时推得；宫干是飞宫四化的起点，宫干排错，后面所有飞化都会跟着错，这是自己排盘和校盘必须过的一关。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数一个宫管好几种人和事：十二宫的多重身份别只按名字理解
enTitle: One Palace, Many Roles in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Don't Read the Twelve Palaces Only by Name
enDesc: A palace's name is only its most common role; each actually governs several people and matters: Career is work but also the qi-number position, Property is housing but also the head of household and storage, Children is kids but also partnerships, creativity and romance. Open all of a palace's roles to explain seemingly unrelated events happening together.
cnDesc: 十二宫的宫名只是它最常用的身份，实际上每个宫都同时管几类人和事：官禄宫既是工作也是气数位、田宅宫既是房子也是一家之主与收藏、子女宫既是孩子也是合伙、创作与桃花。读盘要把一宫的多重身份一起打开，才能解释那些「看似不相关却同时发生」的事。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数应期怎么定到月和日：流年只是圈定一年，流月流日才落点
enTitle: Narrowing Timing in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Year Only Frames Twelve Months, Flowing Month and Day Pin the Point
enDesc: The annual chart only says a matter is activated within the year; which month or even days needs the flowing-month chart to narrow, and flowing-day for a concrete window when necessary. The year sets whether, the month sets season/month, the day sets short action points—each layer finer, and reading days while skipping the year is meaningless.
cnDesc: 流年盘只能告诉你「这一年这件事被引动」，真正落到哪个月、甚至哪几天，要继续用流月盘收窄、必要时用流日定具体窗口：流年定有无、流月定季节月份、流日定短期动作点，一层比一层细，跳过年直接看流日是没有意义的。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数火铃夹命是什么格局：两邻夹着火铃的急性能量怎么化
enTitle: The Mars-Bell Flanking Pattern in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Handling the Acute Energy of Being Flanked by Huo Xing and Ling Xing
enDesc: When Mars (Huo Xing) and Bell (Ling Xing) occupy the two neighbors of the Life Palace (Parents and Siblings), it is Mars-Bell flanking. Mars is overt urgency and Bell is hidden grinding; the Life Palace between them is wrapped in two acute energies, suggesting a quick temper and sudden setbacks. Yet flanking is only external force—whether it becomes a harsh pattern depends on the Life star's strength and whether Lu/Quan/Ke or Kui/Yue bridges it.
cnDesc: 命宫的两邻（父母宫与兄弟宫）分别坐着火星、铃星，就叫火铃夹命。火是明急、铃是暗磨，夹在中间的命宫长期被一明一暗两种急性能量裹着，主性子急、易突发波折；但夹宫只是外力，能不能成「凶格」还要看命宫主星强弱与有没有禄权科、魁钺来通关。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数空劫夹命：被地空地劫夹着的宫位为什么容易「漏」，怎么守
enTitle: The Empty-Robbed Flanking Pattern in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why a Palace Flanked by Di Kong and Di Jie Leaks, and How to Guard It
enDesc: When Di Kong (Empty) and Di Jie (Robbed) flank a palace, that matter is affected: Di Kong is mental emptiness, spirituality and breaking frame; Di Jie is real-world robbery and resources pulled away. One abstract and one concrete neighbor make the flanked palace hard to grasp and prone to loss, especially in Wealth and Property. Yet Empty/Robbed also bring creativity and frame-breaking; the key is knowing what leaks and what structure guards it.
cnDesc: 某宫的两邻分别是地空、地劫，就叫空劫夹命（夹哪个宫就影响哪件事）。地空主想法上的空、精神性与跳脱，地劫主现实里的劫、资源被抽走，两邻一虚一实夹着，让被夹的宫位「抓不住、易流失」，在财帛田宅尤其明显；但空劫也主创意与跳出框架，关键是分清它漏的是什么、用什么结构去守。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年十二神煞：岁建、晦气、丧门、官符、白虎怎么只做加减分
enTitle: The Twelve Annual Spirit Stars in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Sui Jian, Hui Qi, Sang Men, Guan Fu, Bai Hu as Adjustments Only
enDesc: From the annual Life palace, twelve spirit stars are placed in order each year—Sui Jian, Hui Qi, Sang Men, Guan Suo, Guan Fu, Xiao Hao, Da Hao (Tian Xi), Long De, Bai Hu, Tian De, Diao Ke, Bing Fu. They are weather tags for the year, marking which month or domain tends to small blockage or small joy; they are only a temporary adjustment layer, while major stars and transformations carry the main reading—never predict disaster from one Bai Hu.
cnDesc: 流年命宫起，每年顺布岁建、晦气、丧门、贯索、官符、小耗、大耗（天喜）、龙德、白虎、天德、吊客、病符十二神煞，它们像一年的「天气标签」，标注哪个月、哪个领域易有小阻滞或小喜庆；但神煞只做加减分的临时叠加层，主星四化才是主断，绝不能用一颗白虎就断灾。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看你适不适合做自媒体博主、做个人IP：命宫、官禄、迁移、福德这样配
enTitle: Are You Suited to Be a Content Creator in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Life, Career, Travel and Karma for a Personal IP
enDesc: Content creation is productizing yourself, outputting publicly and enduring judgment; read four palaces together: Life for expressive drive and distinctiveness, Career for fit with non-standard content production, Travel for facing陌生 traffic and public feedback, and Karma for surviving data swings and long stretches without steady returns.
cnDesc: 做自媒体本质是「把自己产品化、持续对外输出并承受被评价」，要合看四宫：命宫有没有表达欲和辨识度、官禄适不适合内容生产这种非标准化工作、迁移宫能不能面对陌生流量与公域反馈、福德扛不扛得住数据起伏和长期没有稳定回报的阶段。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看直播、短视频、出镜：哪些星盘组合天生有镜头感
enTitle: Livestreaming and Short Video in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Which Chart Combinations Have Natural Camera Presence
enDesc: Livestream and short video demand real-time expressiveness more than text: read Life for camera presence and improvisation, Career for sustained performance, Travel for state before a live audience, plus speech stars (Ju Men, Wen Qu, Tan Lang). Handling live interaction and dead air is the key difference from text creators.
cnDesc: 直播和短视频比图文更吃「即时表现力」：要同时看命宫的镜头感和临场反应、官禄的持续营业能力、迁移宫面对在线观众的状态，以及口舌星（巨门、文曲、贪狼）的配置；能不能接住实时互动、扛住冷场，是这类工作和做图文博主最大的不同。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看自由职业、数字游民：不坐班的盘长什么样，你适不适合
enTitle: Freelancing and Digital Nomads in Zi Wei Dou Shu: What the No-Office Chart Looks Like and Whether You Fit
enDesc: Freelancing is not skipping work but carrying income stability, self-management, client acquisition and loneliness yourself; read Career (self-direction in unstructured work), Wealth/Property (cash flow without a fixed salary), Travel (remote cross-region collaboration) and Karma (psychological tolerance of solitude and uncertainty).
cnDesc: 自由职业不是「不用上班」，而是把稳定收入、自我管理、客户获取和孤独感全扛在自己身上，要合看官禄（能不能自驱做非结构化工作）、财帛与田宅（没有固定工资时现金流稳不稳）、迁移（远程与跨地域协作）、福德（独处和不确定性的心理承受）。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看35岁前后的中年转型：大限交接为什么是转机也是坎
enTitle: Mid-Career Transition Around 35 in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why the Decade-Limit Handoff Is Both Opening and Hurdle
enDesc: Many in their mid-thirties feel the current path is dead-end yet change feels risky, often a decade-limit handoff: the old limit's star structure exits and a new one takes over. For mid-career transition, locate the current and next limits' palaces and transformations to tell a track-switch window from a harvest-deepening phase in the old field, then use the year to set pace.
cnDesc: 很多人在三十多岁中段感到「现在的路走不下去又不敢换」，这在盘上常对应大限交接：旧大限的星曜结构退场、新大限接管。看中年转型要定位当前大限与下一限的宫位和四化，判断这是「换轨道的窗口期」还是「旧领域深耕的收获期」，再用流年定启动节奏。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看失眠、焦虑、精神内耗：福德宫与疾厄宫的身心信号
enTitle: Insomnia, Anxiety and Overthinking in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Mind-Body Signals From the Karma and Health Palaces
enDesc: Sleeplessness, runaway thoughts and unexplained tension mainly read Karma (mental activity and emotional processing) and Health (where the body holds emotion), plus Life's thinking traits. It flags innate thought patterns and emotional weak spots as tendency, not diagnosis; chronic insomnia and anxiety must rely on formal medical and professional mental-health care.
cnDesc: 睡不着、停不下来地想、莫名紧绷，在盘上主要看福德宫（精神活动、情绪运作方式）与疾厄宫（身体承接情绪的部位），再参考命宫的思维特质；它能提示你天生的思虑模式和情绪薄弱环节，但这是倾向不是诊断，长期失眠焦虑必须以正规医院和专业心理干预为准。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看减肥和自律：为什么总坚持不下来，命盘里的自控力怎么用
enTitle: Weight Control and Discipline in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Consistency Fails and How to Use Your Chart's Self-Control
enDesc: Things like weight loss, fitness and early rising that rely on repeated small actions mainly read Career (execution and discipline structure), Karma (instant versus delayed gratification) and Life's action style, plus Health's constitution tendency. It explains the binge-quit cycle and gives habit strategies aligned with star nature rather than against human nature.
cnDesc: 减肥、健身、早起这类「靠长期重复小行动见效」的事，主要看官禄（执行力与自律结构）、福德（即时满足还是延迟满足）、命宫的行动风格，以及疾厄提示的体质倾向；它解释你为什么总在「猛冲—放弃」之间循环，并给出顺着星性、而不是逆着人性的习惯策略。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看你的消费观：财帛、福德、田宅决定你为什么存不住钱
enTitle: Your Spending Style in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Wealth, Karma and Property Explain Why Money Never Stays
enDesc: How someone spends, why they cannot resist buying and whether they save read Wealth (spending manner), Karma (whether money buys joy or reassurance) and Property (whether money settles into assets). Combinations map to reward, status, anxiety and hoarding spending types; naming yours lets you design the right saving structure.
cnDesc: 一个人怎么花钱、为什么总忍不住剁手、能不能攒下钱，要合看财帛（花钱的方式）、福德（花钱买的是快乐还是安心）、田宅（钱能不能沉淀成资产）；不同组合对应犒赏型、面子型、焦虑型、囤积型等消费模式，看清自己是哪型，才好对症设储蓄结构。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看社恐、慢热、i人e人：命盘里的社交能量是怎么配置的
enTitle: Social Reserve, Slow Warmth and Introvert/Extrovert in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How the Chart Allocates Social Energy
enDesc: Whether you like socializing and whether crowds charge or drain you mainly read Life (innate energy direction), Travel (state before strangers), Friends (peer-relating mode) and Karma (whether solitude or company relaxes you). Social reserve, slow warmth and rising to a crowd are not flaws but different energy configurations; seeing yours lets you choose fitting social and work styles.
cnDesc: 爱不爱社交、人多了是充电还是耗电，主要看命宫（天生的能量方向）、迁移宫（面对陌生人群的状态）、交友宫（和朋友同辈的相处模式）与福德（独处还是共处更放松）；社恐、慢热、人来疯不是缺点而是能量配置不同，看清配置才能选对适合自己的社交和工作方式。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看讨好型人格：为什么总不敢拒绝，边界感怎么立起来
enTitle: People-Pleasing in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why You Cannot Say No and How to Build Boundaries
enDesc: Habitual people-pleasing, fear of conflict and putting others first mainly read Life (innate agreeableness versus assertiveness), Karma (whether being needed provides security), Friends/Siblings (your position among peers) and Parents (how early treatment internalized "be good to deserve love"). Seeing the source lets you build boundaries without destroying relationships.
cnDesc: 习惯性讨好、怕冲突、把别人的需求排在自己前面，主要看命宫（天生的随和或强势程度）、福德（是否靠被需要获得安全感）、交友与兄弟（同辈关系里的位置）、父母宫（早期被对待的方式如何内化成「要乖才值得被爱」）；看清讨好的来源，才可能在不破坏关系的前提下立住边界。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看被裁员、被优化：怎么用大限流年判断是危机还是转场
enTitle: Layoffs in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Using the Decade and Year to Tell Crisis From a Pivot
enDesc: Being laid off or optimized off reads on three layers: the decade for whether the career line is in overall decline, the year for whether this is only a phase hit, and Career/Parents/Wealth/Property together for re-employment difficulty and runway. The chart cannot save your job but helps separate an industry pivot from a temporary setback, deciding whether to find similar work fast or use the moment to switch tracks.
cnDesc: 被裁、被优化、被迫离职，要分三层看：大限看官禄这条线是不是整体在走下坡，流年看今年是不是只是阶段性冲击，官禄、父母、财帛、田宅合看判断再就业难度和能撑多久；盘不能替你保住工作，但能帮你分清这是「行业性转场」还是「一时波折」，从而决定是赶紧找同类岗位还是借机换赛道。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看往哪个城市、哪个方向发展：迁移宫、天马和方位怎么用
enTitle: Which City and Direction to Develop in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Travel Palace, Tian Ma and Direction
enDesc: Whether to leave home, which direction, big city or small, mainly reads Travel (going out and the social stage), the Life-Travel axis (whether you flourish locally or away) and Tian Ma (the drive to move), plus star five-element correspondence with direction. It gives a tendency of smoothness and environment type; concrete city choice still weighs jobs, family and real costs.
cnDesc: 适不适合离开家乡、去哪个方位、大城市还是小城市，主要看迁移宫（外出与社会舞台）、命迁线（本地还是在外更舒展）、天马（移动的动力），再结合星曜五行与方位的对应；它给的是「顺不顺、往哪类环境走」的倾向，具体城市选择仍要综合工作机会、家庭和现实成本。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看买车换车：迁移、财帛、田宅怎么定时机和预算
enTitle: Buying or Replacing a Car in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Travel, Wealth and Property Set Timing and Budget
enDesc: A car mainly belongs to the Travel palace (mobility tools and away-from-home state) while touching Wealth (a large one-off expense and loan payments) and Property (household asset allocation). When to buy, at what price, loan or full payment combine Travel's need, Wealth's capacity and Property's asset safety, then the year sets the window to avoid an impulse purchase burdening you beyond budget.
cnDesc: 车在盘里主要归迁移宫（出行工具与在外状态），同时牵动财帛（一次性大额支出与还贷）、田宅（家庭资产配置）；什么时候买、买什么价位、贷款还是全款，要把迁移的需求、财帛的承受力和田宅的资产安全合起来看，再用流年定合适的出手窗口，避免冲动购车背上超预算的负担。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看备孕求子：子女宫、大限流年怎么看子女缘和时机（倾向非定论）
enTitle: Trying to Conceive in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Children Palace, Decade and Year for Child Affinity and Timing (Tendency, Not Destiny)
enDesc: When to have a child, how strong the child affinity and how smooth the process traditionally read the Children palace (the child's state and affinity), Property (household capacity) and Spouse (whether the couple is aligned), then decade/year for activated periods. But the chart reflects only tendency and timing; whether and when conception is possible and whether medical help is needed is entirely decided by formal reproductive-health exams and doctors—never replace care with the chart or limit yourself by it.
cnDesc: 什么时候适合要孩子、子女缘深不深、过程顺不顺，传统上主要看子女宫（子女的状态与缘分）、田宅（家庭承载）、夫妻（两人是否同心），再用大限流年看引动的时段；但命盘只反映一种倾向和节奏，能不能怀、何时怀、是否需要医学辅助，完全以正规医院的生殖健康检查和医生意见为准，绝不能用命盘替代就医或给自己设限。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看你和宠物的缘分：子女宫、福德宫看你适不适合养、养什么
enTitle: Your Affinity With Pets in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Children and Karma Palaces for Whether and What to Keep
enDesc: Pets are usually read through the Children palace (which also covers cherished small beings in your care and "juniors"), Karma for whether you have the mindset for companionship and care, and Property for whether housing allows it. Whether to keep one, what type and when combine these palaces to tell long-term responsibility from a passing whim, avoiding adoption then abandonment.
cnDesc: 宠物在斗数里通常借子女宫看（它也代表自己疼爱的、需要照护的小生命与「晚辈」），福德宫看你有没有陪伴和照料的心境，田宅宫看居住条件是否允许；适不适合养、养什么类型、什么时候养，把这几宫合看，能帮你判断自己是「能长期负责」还是「一时兴起」，避免养了又弃。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数里的择日择时：流年流月流日怎么帮你挑办事窗口，以及它的边界
enTitle: Date and Time Selection in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How Year-Month-Day Layers Pick Windows to Act, and Their Limits
enDesc: For signing, opening, moving, confessing or interviewing, Zi Wei picks a smoother time through the year for the big window, month for the key period, day for the concrete action date. But timing changes the smoothness and pace of acting, not the outcome itself; with unready conditions even the best date fails—know what timing can and cannot do.
cnDesc: 签约、开业、搬家、表白、面试这些事想挑个顺一点的时间，斗数是通过流年定大窗口、流月定重点时段、流日挑具体动作日来实现的；但择时改变的是「出手的顺逆和节奏」，不是事情的成败本身，条件不成熟时挑再好的日子也难成，要分清择时能做什么、不能做什么。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看职场PUA：怎么从官禄父母交友宫识别精神控制并抽身
enTitle: Workplace PUA in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Spotting Mental Manipulation Through Career, Parents and Friends and Getting Out
enDesc: Persistent denial, empty promises, confidence-breaking and emotional blackmail by a manager are classic workplace PUA; the chart reads Career (role power relation), Parents (direct and higher leaders) and Friends (colleagues' situation and reputation) to show the power structure and why you are susceptible. Its role is pattern recognition and preserving judgment; real evidence, rights protection and exit rely on action and formal channels.
cnDesc: 被领导持续否定、画饼、打压自信、情感绑架，是职场PUA的典型表现；盘上可从官禄（岗位权力关系）、父母（直属与更高上级）、交友（同事处境与口碑）看出你在什么样的权力结构里、为什么容易被控制，但命盘的作用是帮你识别模式和留住判断力，真正的取证、维权和离开要靠现实行动与正规途径。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看裸辞和间隔年：什么时候可以停下来，什么时候只是逃避
enTitle: Quitting Without a Next Job and Gap Years in Zi Wei Dou Shu: When to Pause and When It Is Just Escape
enDesc: Whether quitting without a next job or taking a gap is active recharging or passive escape reads Career (whether the job truly ran its course), Wealth/Property (how long savings last), Karma (whether pausing recharges or worsens anxiety) and Travel (whether new chances enter during the break), then decade/year to tell pre-turn buildup from downward escape.
cnDesc: 裸辞、gap、休整一段时间，到底是主动蓄力还是被动逃避，要合看官禄（这份工作是不是真的走到头）、财帛田宅（积蓄能撑多久）、福德（停下来是充电还是更焦虑）、迁移（休整期有没有新机会进来），再用大限流年判断这是「转折前的蓄力」还是「下行中的逃避」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看丁克、不生育：命盘里怎么看生育意愿，选择该由谁定
enTitle: The Childfree Choice in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How the Chart Shows Parenting Willingness and Who Gets to Choose
enDesc: Whether someone wants children and suits the traditional parenting path reads Children (affinity and relating mode with children), Spouse (partner alignment), Karma (the life one wants) and Life (priority of self-realization). The chart only shows tendency; to have or not is an autonomous choice based on reality and values, and no one should be bound by a claim of "fated to have/no children."
cnDesc: 一个人想不想要孩子、适不适合走传统育儿路径，可从子女宫（与子女的缘分和相处模式）、夫妻宫（伴侣是否同心）、福德（自己想要怎样的生活）、命宫（自我实现的优先级）合看；但命盘只显示倾向，生与不生是个人和伴侣基于现实与价值观的自主选择，绝不能用「命中有无子女」来绑架任何人。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看网恋、社交软件脱单：迁移、交友、夫妻宫怎么联动
enTitle: Online Dating in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How Travel, Friends and Spouse Palaces Work Together
enDesc: Apps, online romance and meeting from afar follow a path: first meet in Travel (strangers, distance, public domain), then through Friends (learning and interaction) land in Spouse (a defined relationship). Read Travel for online external affinity, Friends for judgment in screening, Spouse for the wanted relationship type, with special care verifying the move from online to offline; the chart gives tendency, safety is yours.
cnDesc: 社交软件、网恋、异地相识，本质是「先在迁移（陌生、远方、公域）相遇，再经交友（了解互动）落到夫妻（确定关系）」的路径；要看迁移宫有没有线上外缘、交友宫筛人的判断力、夫妻宫最终要的关系类型，并特别注意从线上走到线下的风险甄别，盘给倾向，安全靠自己。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看冷暴力、突然断联：关系里的退缩信号怎么读、怎么应对
enTitle: Silent Treatment and Sudden Withdrawal in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Reading Retreat Signals in a Relationship and How to Respond
enDesc: Going silent at conflict, disappearing and punishing through silence read both partners' Spouse (conflict-handling mode), Karma (whether emotion expresses outward or withdraws) and Life temperament. The chart helps distinguish "withdrawal to self-regulate, needing space" from "control through retreat," so you choose effective communication instead of being worn down by the cold shoulder.
cnDesc: 一吵架就不说话、突然失联、用沉默惩罚对方，要从双方夫妻宫（处理冲突的模式）、福德（情绪表达是外放还是内缩）、命宫性格合看；盘能帮你分清对方（和自己）的冷是「需要空间的自我调节」还是「以退为进的控制」，从而选择有效沟通而不是被冷处理拖垮。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看焦虑型、回避型、安全型依恋：命盘里的亲密关系模式
enTitle: Anxious, Avoidant and Secure Attachment in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Intimacy Patterns in the Chart
enDesc: Whether you are anxious-clingy, avoidant-distant or relatively secure in intimacy reads Life (self baseline), Spouse (how you are in intimacy) and Karma (sense of security when alone). Star combinations map to attachment tendencies; knowing your and your partner's type explains why closeness brings fights and distance brings panic, and lets you build safer relating.
cnDesc: 你在亲密关系里是黏人焦虑、疏离回避还是相对安全，可从命宫（自我底色）、夫妻宫（亲密中的样子）、福德（独处时的安全感）合看；不同星曜组合对应不同的依恋倾向，看清自己和伴侣属于哪型，才知道为什么一靠近就吵、一分开就慌，也才练得出更安全的相处。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看闪婚闪离：哪些盘容易冲动定终身，怎么给关系加一道保险
enTitle: Whirlwind Marriage and Quick Divorce in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Which Charts Rush Into Forever and How to Insure the Relationship
enDesc: Marrying soon after meeting and quickly failing reads Life (decision impulsiveness), Spouse (relationship stability), Karma (tolerance for the ordinary and磨合) and Travel (whether passion comes from a stranger-filter). The chart flags combinations easily pushed by infatuation and the decade/year prone to whirlwind marriage, so you deliberately lengthen the decision and insure it with real-world磨合.
cnDesc: 认识不久就结婚、很快又过不下去，要合看命宫（做决定冲不冲动）、夫妻宫（关系稳定度）、福德（能否忍受平淡与磨合）、迁移（激情是否来自陌生滤镜）；盘能提示哪些组合容易被热恋推着走、在哪个大限流年最易闪婚，从而刻意拉长决策、用现实磨合给关系上保险。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看子女教育：按子女宫主星类型选教育方式，比一刀切有效
enTitle: Parenting by the Children Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Matching Education Style to the Star Type Beats One-Size-Fits-All
enDesc: Whether a child responds to softness or firmness, suits strict management or free-range, and which path they excel at can reference the Children-palace star type: pioneering types need a stage and boundaries, leading types responsibility and respect, supportive types encouragement and expression, cooperative types stability and companionship. It offers a lens on innate nature, but every child is an individual; parenting rests on observation and respect, the chart only a reference.
cnDesc: 孩子是吃软还是吃硬、适合严管还是放养、擅长什么路径，可参考子女宫主星的类型：开创型要给舞台和边界、领导型要给责任和尊重、支援型要给鼓励和表达、合作型要给稳定和陪伴；它提供一种理解孩子天性的视角，但每个孩子都是独立个体，教育的根本是观察和尊重，命盘只作参考不替代。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看鸡娃和教育内卷：怎么从子女宫、官禄父母宫把握投入分寸
enTitle: Intensive Parenting and Education Rat-Race in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Gauging Investment From Children, Career and Parents Palaces
enDesc: Whether to push, how hard, and whether the child is academic can reference Children (endowment and pace), Career (long-line academic/career type) and Parents (discipline and document affinity between parent and child). The chart's greater value is helping parents separate the child's growth rhythm from their own anxiety projection, finding the measure between investment and blank space rather than treating the rat race as the only path.
cnDesc: 该不该鸡、鸡到什么程度、孩子是不是读书这块料，可参考子女宫（孩子的禀赋和节奏）、官禄宫（学业事业的长线类型）、父母宫（亲子间的管教与文书缘）；命盘更有价值的用法是帮家长分清「孩子的成长规律」和「自己的焦虑投射」，在投入和留白之间找到分寸，而不是把内卷当成唯一路径。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看孩子青春期叛逆：子女宫、父母宫找对亲子沟通的钥匙
enTitle: Adolescent Rebellion in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Right Communication Key From Children and Parents Palaces
enDesc: A teenager suddenly talking back, closing doors and wanting independence is not going bad but the normal rise of selfhood. The Children star shows the rebellion's form and Parents the smoothness of communication, guiding a shift from manager to advisor. The chart offers a lens; real repair relies on respect, boundaries and dialogue.
cnDesc: 青春期孩子突然顶嘴、关门、要独立，不是学坏，而是自我意识崛起的正常阶段；可参考子女宫主星看孩子叛逆的表现形式、父母宫看亲子沟通顺不顺，从而调整管教姿态——这个阶段父母要从「管理者」转成「顾问」，盘提供理解角度，真正的关系修复靠尊重、边界和沟通。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看原生家庭：父母宫如何塑造你处理关系和权威的惯性
enTitle: Family of Origin in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How the Parents Palace Shapes Your Relationship and Authority Habits
enDesc: The Parents palace reads more than your bond with parents; it writes the earliest patterns learned at home for relating to authority, expressing needs and deserving love, which replay in adult boss and intimate relationships. Seeing this pattern serves awareness and release, not blaming life or convicting your parents.
cnDesc: 父母宫不只看你和父母的缘分，也写一个人最早在家庭里学到的「怎么和权威相处、怎么表达需求、值不值得被爱」的底层模式；它会在成年后的上下级关系、亲密关系里反复重演。看清这套模式是为了觉察和松绑，而不是给人生甩锅或给父母定罪。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数多久算一次合适：为什么不建议同一件事反复算
enTitle: How Often to Read Your Chart in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Re-Asking the Same Question Harms You
enDesc: A chart reads long-term structure and phase trends, not a daily changing answer; re-asking the same matter across readers and tools in a short window only confuses and drains action into reassurance-seeking. A sound rhythm is structure once, at each decade handoff once, and for a concrete major decision once before choosing; the rest of the time, live the known direction well.
cnDesc: 命盘看的是长期结构和阶段趋势，不是每天变动的答案；同一件事短期内反复找不同人算、换着工具测，只会越算越乱、把行动力耗在求证里。合理的节奏是「结构看一次、大限转换看一次、具体大事在决策前看一次」，其余时间用来把已知的方向过好。
